correctness.rationale: Exact symmetric weighted Laplacian Cayley–Hamilton polynomial and rational quotient are derived explicitly and independently checked with symbolic identities and 672 exact rational direct matrix inversions. All quantifiers (three nodes, nonnegative weights, tau>0, h>=0) and q_w sign boundaries are explicit. Scalar Gauss eigenvalue function proves diagonal positivity and unconditional spectral stability; critical quadratic gives the single sharp nonreentrant horizon; pseudoinverse and 2-node claims follow from direct identities. Tests are corroboration, not an infinite-family proof.

originality.rationale: Actual semantic published-finding corpus searches for three-state Gauss/Padé graph positivity, the most relevant published same-method finite-state record, accessible own historical claim deduplication, and historical primary literature were compared by theorem implication. None of the inspected statements yields the exact weighted three-site unconditional/finite-root dichotomy; all observed special-case coverage is explicitly excluded from standalone novelty. Residual unindexed or incompletely inspected literature remains possible.
residual_risks: Specialized older weighted Markov-chain rational-step literature could contain an equivalent formulation outside searched indexing.

Self-review originality assessment is not independent verification.

value.rationale: The natural complete three-state symmetric diffusion family has a fully explicit sharp order-four positive-endpoint classification, identifying exact one-edge-conductance imbalance, a Green-kernel criterion and minimal dimension for finite-step negative transitions despite spectral stability. The sharp weighted-path ratio and strong-edge asymptotics provide motivated structural interpretation useful in reversible Markov and diffusion discretization; this is not a numerical instance or general method-wide textbook deduction.
